name: fruitback
description: Visual feedback widget that plants annotations on a live page and grows them into Linear issues.

scripts.dev: bash -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; pnpm --filter @fruitback/worker dev:fake & pnpm --filter @fruitback/playground dev; wait'
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @sakuga/fruitback-shared build && pnpm --filter @sakuga/fruitback-widget build && playwright test
